name: Arleigh Burke class (Flight IIA)
note: DDG-51 Flight IIA Aegis guided-missile destroyer with the SPY-1D(V) phased-array radar and 96 Mk-41 VLS cells (32 forward + 64 aft) firing SM-2/SM-6, ESSM, VLA and Tomahawk. Two MH-60R helicopters. Figures are for Flight IIA (DDG-79 onward); the newer Flight III adds the SPY-6 AMDR. VLS count and radar range are not on the Navy fact file.

name: Type 052D (Luyang III)
note: PLAN Luyang III guided-missile destroyer, China's most numerous modern DDG ('Chinese Aegis'). Type 346A four-panel AESA radar and 64 universal VLS cells (32 fwd + 32 aft) firing HHQ-9 SAM, YJ-18 anti-ship and CJ-10 land-attack missiles. Carries a Harbin Z-9 helicopter (Z-20 on the stretched 052DL). Displacement and crew are not in the retrieved excerpt.

name: Type 45 (Daring class)
note: Royal Navy Daring-class air-defence destroyer built around the Sea Viper (PAAMS) system with the SAMPSON multi-function AESA and S1850M long-range radars. 48 Sylver A50 VLS cells for Aster 15/30 (24 Sea Ceptor silos being added from 2026). Heavily reduced radar signature. Crew and speed are not in the retrieved excerpt.

name: Kolkata class
note: Indian Navy Kolkata class (Project 15A), India's first stealth destroyers. EL/M-2248 MF-STAR AESA plus Thales LW-08 radar. Air defence uses four 8-cell VLS (32 Barak-8/MRSAM cells); the primary offensive load is 16 BrahMos in a Universal Vertical Launcher Module. Enclosed hangar for two helicopters. Crew is not in the retrieved excerpt.

name: Maya class
note: JMSDF Maya class, an enlarged Atago derivative with Aegis Baseline 9C, Cooperative Engagement Capability and ballistic-missile defence (SM-3 Block IIA). AN/SPY-1D(V) radar and 96 Mk-41 VLS cells (one 64-cell + one 32-cell group) for SM-2/SM-3/SM-6 and VLA. Type 17 anti-ship missiles in deck canisters. Helicopter landing deck but no embarked hangar; speed and crew are not in the retrieved excerpt.
